study type: Observational study using a web-based platform
exposure: Various obstetric complications (e.g., eclampsia, postpartum haemorrhage, uterine rupture)
cohort: Pregnant women in hospitals with delivery units in Lower Saxony, Bavaria, and Berlin, Germany
finding: The GerOSS project demonstrated feasibility in collecting data on rare obstetric events and identifying risk factors, allowing for the development of tailored treatment algorithms to improve obstetric care.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was identified as a common risk factor for complications.
